name: Tatyana "Tanya" Tsikanovsky
office: City of West Hollywood, Member of the City Council

items.text: Tatyana “Tanya” Tsikanovsky is a nonprofit executive and the founder of Highly Jewish. She worked on Hillary Clinton’s 2016 presidential campaign and says the October 7, 2023, attacks changed her views. She says she is running to improve public safety and increase government transparency.

sentences.text: Tatyana “Tanya” Tsikanovsky is a nonprofit executive and the founder of Highly Jewish.
She worked on Hillary Clinton’s 2016 presidential campaign and says the October 7, 2023, attacks changed her views.
She says she is running to improve public safety and increase government transparency.

items.text: In a candidate forum, she said she supports incentives for developers to build multi-family housing and cutting red tape, but opposes subsidizing preschool. She called for ADA-compliant sidewalks and addressing homelessness, and said combating burglaries is a priority. She proposed reallocating budget funds to clean parks and safe streets. In another forum, she said she would undo the Fountain Avenue streetscape plan and keep the San Vicente plaza project paused.
